L104: # Clinical Trials & Research
L105: ## How PetCure Oncology Is Advancing Cancer Care For Pets
L106: 
L107: PetCure Oncology is on a mission to revolutionize pet cancer care with stereotactic radiation (SRS/SRT), an advanced form of radiation therapy that has been proven effective in humans. To date, we’ve seen SRS/SRT treat many different types of pet cancers in more than 3,500 patients—and our affiliated clinical specialists are determined to understand the safety and benefits of SRS/SRT on all tumors.
L108: Whether you’re a pet parent or veterinarian, you may be able to take part in a PetCure-sponsored clinical trial. Please see below for more information.
L109: 
L110: Clinical Trials
L111: 
L112: There are no active clinical trials currently recruiting pets within the PetCure Oncology national network. Please check back here or contact us at 833-738-4376 for updates or alternative treatment options.
